title: The Complaint Heard Above the Noise
intro: You hear a voice rising from a society where oppression has become routine. No display of power answers the grievance; instead, a direct appeal reaches Allah, and the response strikes at the heart of worship itself. Who made that complaint, what question followed, and what truth was affirmed?
clues: I became troubled by the oppression of the people around me.
I voiced that grievance directly to Allah in a personal complaint.
Allah heard the complaint and answered with a challenge about my own belief.
The answer asked how I could fail to believe in Allah, who is One and Supreme.
I then asked why Allah should favor a people who were disbelieving.
I am Uzair, named in Surah Az-Zukhruf as the one whose complaint Allah heard.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Uzair
The companion who sailed on the great flood
The servant who walked upon water
The sleeper protected within a cave
The servant who brought stones to a river

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Complaining to Allah about the oppression of the people
Walking upon water during a storm
Carrying stones to a river that lacked water
Sailing through a great flood aboard the Ark
Receiving the key to an immense treasure
trial.answer: Complaining to Allah about the oppression of the people

location.label: Key Element
options: A direct complaint addressed to Allah
A staff that became a serpent
A furnace made cool and peaceful
An ark floating over floodwaters
A fish swallowing a servant
location.answer: A direct complaint addressed to Allah

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Allah heard the complaint and affirmed divine Oneness and Supreme Lordship
Walking safely on water during a storm
Crossing a great flood safely aboard the Ark
Regaining sight within a palace of arrogance
Receiving dominion stretching from the East to the West
outcome.answer: Allah heard the complaint and affirmed divine Oneness and Supreme Lordship

arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verse: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him. (43:7)
